dcat_keyword_sm: A city that is more connected with reliable safe and accessible mobility options
dct_description_sm:
The data presented represents captured volumes at the identified locations, using video cameras. The duration of each count followed the City of Ottawa standard 8-hour period: 7:00am to 10:00am, 11:30am to 1:30pm and 3:00pm to 6:00pm. The number of data captures conducted varies from month to month. Percentages indicated represent all vehicle modes observed in mixed use travel lanes. Calculations are based off historical pre-COVID data corresponding to the same intervals. The AM percentage values focus on the time period: 7:00am to 10:00am and the PM period: 3:00pm to 6:00pm. Intent of data is to provide the percent of volume at the observed location at a stated time point, expressed as for the month of ‘x’, volume was at ‘x’% of pre-COVID volumes.

Accuracy: The data captured is accurate to a minimum of 95%; the City of Ottawa provides this information in good faith but provides no warranty, nor accepts any liability arising from any incorrect, incomplete or misleading information or its improper use.

Update Frequency: Monthly

Attributes: Location, month, year, average (Y/N), AM, PM, 8HR, X,Y, Latitude and Longitude

Contact: Byron Hemlow & Cristina Ferrante | Transportation Services, Traffic Services
dct_title_s: COVID-19 Traffic Volume Monitoring at Intersections
